column2: mm: Revert to checking pmd/pte_write instead of VMA flags

column1: 4d9424669946 (""mm: convert p[te|md]_mknonnuma and remaining page table manipulations"")
changed NUMA balancing from _PAGE_NUMA to using PROT_NONE
found to introduce a regression with NUMA grouping.
It was followed up by these commits:
53da3bc2ba9e (""mm: fix up numa read-only thread grouping logic"")
bea66fbd11af (""mm: numa: group related processes based on VMA flags instead of page table flags"")
b191f9b106ea (""mm: numa: preserve PTE write permissions across a NUMA hinting fault"")
The first of those two commits try alternate approaches to NUMA

column2: which apparently do not work as well as looking at the PTE

column1: The latter patch preserves the PTE write permissions across a NUMA

column2: it forgets to revert the condition for

column1: whether or not to group tasks together back to what it was before

column2: even though the information is now preserved in the page tables

column1: This patch brings the NUMA grouping heuristic back to what it was
We have all the information again. We should probably use it.
